certificationUse.text: The certification mark, as intended to be used by persons authorized by the certifier, certifies that the services are provided by persons who have attained a specific level of education, training, and experience in the field of providing assistance to deafblind individuals in their daily living activities and communications. A copy of the complete details of the standard are enclosed with this application and accessible to the public in the records of the Canadian Intellectual Property Office.
